mails.subject: Eksklusiv investering med garanteret afkast
mails.body:
Hej

Jeg skriver til dig fordi du er blevet udvalgt til en lukket investeringsmulighed i et nyt grønt energiprojekt.
Vi garanterer 14 procent afkast på 90 dage, uden risiko.
Minimumsindskud er 2.000 DKK, og pengene overføres til vores klientkonto i udlandet.
Der er kun få pladser tilbage, og tilbuddet udløber søndag aften.
Skriv tilbage med dit telefonnummer, så ringer jeg til dig i morgen.

Mvh
Frederik Lindegaard
mails.justification: Investment scam promising guaranteed returns with a foreign transfer, from a stranger.

mails.subject: Offres d'emploi à diffuser auprès de vos membres
mails.body:
Bonjour,

Je suis consultante chez Talentia Recrutement. Nous avons actuellement 12 postes ouverts à Copenhague pour des profils francophones : commerciaux, chefs de projet et développeurs.
Nous souhaiterions que vous diffusiez ces offres auprès des membres de votre espace.
En échange, nous versons une commission de 300 EUR pour chaque candidat recruté.
La liste complète des postes est disponible sur talentia-recrutement.example/offres.
N'hésitez pas à me répondre pour recevoir les fiches de poste.

Cordialement,
Claire Dubois

- Card ending: 4417

mails.subject: Re: Last chance to join Founders Summit Live
mails.body:
Hi again,

> Founders Summit Live is back this November, and we would love to see you there.

Just a quick follow up since I have not heard back from you. We are now at 85 percent capacity and early bird tickets close on Friday.

What you get at Founders Summit Live (November 19 to 20, Copenhagen):
- 40 speakers from 12 countries
- Two days of workshops on growth, funding and product
- Networking dinner on the first evening
- A free copy of our 2026 Founders Report

Tickets start at 190 EUR for general admission. Teams of five or more get 25 percent off. If you run a community or coworking space, we also offer a partner package where you receive a commission on every ticket sold with your code.

We are also hosting a free online preview session next Tuesday at 16:00 where our programme director will walk you through the schedule. Register at summitlive-events.example/preview.

Hope to see you there!

Monika Rautio
Partnerships Manager, Summit Live Events
To stop receiving our emails, reply STOP.
mails.justification: Mass event marketing in a fake follow-up thread; the space never subscribed or replied.

mails.subject: Weekend note: 40 candidates available for your members' companies
mails.body:
Hi,

Apologies for writing on a Sunday evening, this is the only time I get to catch up with my outreach list.

I run BoldHire Network, a staffing and recruitment company working with startups across the Nordics. We currently have more than 40 vetted candidates available for roles in sales, marketing, operations and engineering.

Many of them are looking for a position in Copenhagen starting in November. Salaries range from 38,000 to 65,000 DKK per month depending on the role and seniority.

Since you run a space full of growing companies, I thought you might know which of them are hiring. We work on a success fee only, 15 percent of the first year salary, no upfront cost.

Here is what I suggest:
1. You forward this email to your members or post our link in your community channel.
2. Any company interested replies to me directly.
3. We send them three matching profiles within 48 hours.

You can also see our candidate pool at boldhire-network.example/candidates. We pay a 500 EUR referral bonus for each placement that comes through your space.

Let me know if I can send you a one page overview.

Best regards,
James Whitmore
Founder, BoldHire Network
mails.justification: Recruitment and staffing blast from a stranger, sent on a Sunday evening, asking the space to relay it.
